# LibreOffice Calc GUI Interface Description

## Application Window

- **Title Bar**: Displays "NetIncome.xlsx - LibreOffice Calc"
- **System Tray**: Shows date and time "Oct 23 00:18" with a notification bell icon
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, Maximize, and Close buttons on the top-right corner
- **Application Menu Bar**: Contains File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Styles, Sheet, Data, Tools, Window, Help
- **Toolbar**: Contains various icons for common actions like saving, printing, formatting, and data manipulation
- **Status Bar**: Located at the bottom, showing "Sheet 1 of 1", "PageStyle_Sheet1", "English (Hong Kong)", and "Average: ; Sum: 0"

## Active Document

- **Workbook Name**: "NetIncome.xlsx"
- **Sheet Tab**: "Sheet1" is active
- **Data Table**: Contains two columns labeled "Revenue" (Column A) and "Total Expenses" (Column B) with numerical data from rows 2 to 20
- **Cell Selection**: Cell H10 is selected, which is in the header row of the spreadsheet
- **Cell Formatting**: Font size is set to "11 pt"

## Save Dialog Window

- **Window Title**: "Save" dialog box
- **Cancel Button**: Located at the top-left of the dialog
- **Name Field**: Text field with "NetIncome" entered, highlighted with an orange border
- **Search Icon**: Magnifying glass icon next to the Name field
- **Save Button**: Green button labeled "Save" on the top-right
- **Navigation Panel**: Left sidebar with directory options
  - **Home**: Currently selected, highlighted in orange
  - **Desktop**
  - **Documents**
  - **Downloads**
  - **Music**
  - **Pictures**
  - **Videos**
  - **Other Locations**
- **Breadcrumb Navigation**: Shows current path as "<home> / user"
- **File List**: Displays contents of the current directory
  - **Folders**: .cache, .config, .gnupg, .ipython, .local, .mozilla, .pki, .ssh, .thunderbird, .var, .vscode, Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Music, Pictures, Public, server, snap, Templates, Videos
  - **Files**: NetIncome.html (8.0 KB, Markup, Modified: 00:16 on 11 Mar 2024)
- **Column Headers**: "Name", "Size", "Type", "Modified"
- **File Type Selector**: At the bottom, dropdown menu showing "XHTML (.html;.xhtml)"

## Desktop Environment

- **Left Sidebar**: Contains application icons including Chrome, Thunderbird, Visual Studio Code, VLC, LibreOffice Writer, LibreOffice Calc, LibreOffice Impress, GIMP, Files, Software, Help, and Trash
- **Top Bar**: Displays "Activities" on the left, system icons on the right
- **System Tray Icons**: Volume control, network, and other system indicators

## LibreOffice Calc Specific Elements

- **Formula Bar**: Shows "H10" and formula input area with "f. Σ ="
- **Sheet Navigation**: Sheet tabs at the bottom, currently showing "Sheet1"
- **Zoom Control**: Located at the bottom-right, showing "100%"
- **Right Sidebar**: Contains icons for formatting, functions, and other tools

## Additional UI Elements

- **Help Messages**: Two informational messages at the top-left of the spreadsheet
  - "Help us make LibreOffice even better!"
  - "Your donations support our worldwide community"
- **Action Buttons**: "Get involved" and "Donate" buttons on the right side of the spreadsheet
- **Scroll Bars**: Vertical scroll bar on the right side of the spreadsheet
- **Grid Lines**: Visible grid lines in the spreadsheet for cell alignment

## System Information

- **Language Setting**: "English (Hong Kong)" displayed in the status bar
- **Average and Sum**: "Average: ; Sum: 0" displayed in the status bar
- **Cell Reference**: "H10" displayed in the formula bar

## File System Information

- **Current Directory**: "/home/user"
- **File Types**: Various file types including folders (e.g., .cache, .config) and files (e.g., NetIncome.html)
- **File Sizes**: Sizes displayed in KB (e.g., 8.0 KB for NetIncome.html)
- **Modification Dates**: Dates displayed in the "Modified" column (e.g., 26 Sep 2024, 5 Aug 2025)

## User Interface Design

- **Color Scheme**: Light gray background with white dialog boxes
- **Button Colors**: Green "Save" button, white "Cancel"
